My name is Carlos. I am 30 years old and I am from Brazil. I live in a small apartment in New York. There are two rooms and a kitchen. I work in a restaurant every day from nine to five. I usually have lunch at noon. At the weekend, I like walking in the park and cooking for my friends. Today it is sunny, so I am going to play football with them. I love my new city, but I miss my family.

Last Saturday, I woke up early. I cleaned my apartment and I cooked lunch. After lunch, I called my mother and we talked for an hour. Then I visited my friend Lara. We watched a movie and we laughed a lot. I didn't study, and I didn't go to the gym. At night, I was very tired, so I stayed at home and listened to music.

Yesterday I took the bus to work. I sat next to a woman, and I found a wallet on the seat. I gave it to the driver. He told me, "Thank you!" The woman saw it and said, "That is my wallet!" She was very happy. She bought me a coffee and we talked for ten minutes. I came to work late, but my boss understood. It was a great day.

In Rio, the weather is hotter, and the people are as friendly as in any other city. My favorite city is Rio, because it is the most beautiful place I know. For work, São Paulo is better.

I love traveling. I have visited five countries: Argentina, Chile, the United States, Portugal and Japan. I have been to Japan twice, and I have eaten sushi in Tokyo. I have never been to Africa, but I would like to go. My brother has been to Egypt and he has seen the pyramids. He has gone to Canada this month, so he isn't here now. Have you ever traveled abroad?

Last summer, I went to Canada for the first time. I had never been abroad before, so I was very nervous. I arrived in Toronto on a rainy Monday, and my luggage was lost at the airport. Luckily, the airline found it two days later. I stayed with a friend who has lived there for ten years. We visited the CN Tower, ate a lot of good food and took a train to Niagara Falls. The falls were bigger than I expected. If I have enough money next year, I will go back. I think it is the most beautiful country I have ever visited.
What are you going to do this weekend, Ben?
I'm not sure. If it is sunny, I will go to the beach. And you?
